p:
JIODi Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of kiosks and digital display solutions.

We provide a wide range of products, including self-service kiosks, payment kiosks, barrier-free kiosks, digital signage, and interactive displays.

With our expertise in customized hardware design and manufacturing, we deliver reliable, high-quality solutions tailored to various industries and customer requirements.

JIODi is committed to continuous innovation, product quality, and building long-term partnerships in the global market.

Touchscreen / Payment Device Integration / Custom Design

JIODi's Self-Service Payment Kiosk is a customizable hardware solution designed for unmanned ordering and payment applications. It supports the integration of touchscreen displays and payment-related devices. With flexible design and manufacturing capabilities, JIODi provides customized kiosk solutions for retail stores, restaurants, and various commercial environments.

Interactive Touch Display / Custom Sizes / OEM & ODM

JIODi's Smart Information Kiosk provides interactive touchscreen solutions for information delivery, digital guidance, and self-service applications. Available in various display sizes and customized configurations, it is suitable for public institutions, commercial facilities, and industrial environments. JIODi supports OEM and ODM manufacturing based on customer requirements.
